purpose: If Gate004 identifies a compact radial codec, test whether sub-4-bit directional compression is specific to the scalar fixed angular grid or survives a structured vector-quantization comparator inspired by NSNQuant/shape-gain literature.

literature_boundary.LLVQ: Prior art establishes LLM shape-gain quantization with separate magnitude/direction and spherical/lattice directional coding, primarily for weights; do not claim invention of shape-gain.
literature_boundary.NSNQuant: Prior art establishes Hadamard + token normalization + a reusable low-bit VQ codebook for KV-cache compression at 1-2 bits; any residual-stream adaptation here must be labeled an adaptation, not NSNQuant proper.
literature_boundary.KVarN: Prior art establishes that token-scale errors can drive autoregressive KV-cache error accumulation and that Hadamard plus variance normalization can mitigate it.

entry_condition: Gate004 must yield at least one radial codec satisfying NLL <= exact-radius NLL + 0.10 and NLL < matched Hadamard dynamic A4 on the frozen native BitNet protocol. Otherwise STOP and do not run Gate005.

protocol.radial_codec: minimum passing cascaded bit-width from Gate004
protocol.a1: stretch only; not a primary gate

conditions: fixed scalar angular A4 + selected radial codec
fixed scalar angular A3 + selected radial codec
fixed scalar angular A2 + selected radial codec
grouped VQ A2 + selected radial codec using 4-D groups and 256-codeword shared codebook (2 bits/element)
grouped VQ A2 + exact radius control
shifted-radius negative control for the best A2 directional code

vq_comparator.label: NSNQuant-inspired residual-stream VQ adaptation
vq_comparator.preprocessing: token RMS normalization followed by the same block-Hadamard transform as the scalar angular conditions; no per-token rescaling after normalization other than the separately coded radial variable
vq_comparator.codebook_primary: single reusable synthetic-Gaussian codebook, deterministic seed, optimized before evaluation without using evaluation tokens
vq_comparator.codebook_hostile_control: calibration-trained k-means codebook on calibration residual directions at exactly the same K and group dimension

primary_rules.sub4_success: At least one A3/A2 condition has NLL < matched dynamic A4 and remains better than its shifted-radius control by >= 0.25 NLL.
primary_rules.a2_scalar_success: scalar angular A2 + selected radial codec NLL < matched dynamic A4 NLL.
primary_rules.a2_vq_success: best frozen A2 VQ comparator + selected radial codec NLL < matched dynamic A4 NLL.
primary_rules.representation_generalization: If both scalar-A2 and VQ-A2 beat matched dynamic A4, radial/angular separation is not specific to one directional code family.
primary_rules.vq_preemption: If VQ-A2 beats scalar-A2 by >= 0.10 NLL, future novelty claims must center on radial preservation / residual application rather than the scalar angular grid.
primary_rules.stop: If neither A3 nor A2 beats matched dynamic A4, park sub-4-bit activation claims and retain only the A4 representation result.

rate_accounting: Report angular bits/element plus radial overhead m/2560 separately; codebook storage is amortized and must also be reported for VQ, not silently ignored.
prohibitions: Do not call the residual-stream VQ adaptation NSNQuant proper.
Do not claim novelty for shape-gain decomposition.
Do not tune on evaluation tokens.
Do not reopen A1 unless A2 passes.
Do not promote speed/energy claims from Transformers pseudo/functional execution; those require kernel-level benchmarking.
